{{Top|leg}}
'''Ta'sharr''' was a verbal story-telling that was held daily among [[Drall/Legends|Drall]] families, under the direction of [[Duke/Legends|Duchesses]]&mdash;Drall family leaders. The Drall [[Elamm]] was an unusually quiet for a member of his species and he rarely attended Ta'sharr tellings.<ref name="CCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>
